emerging_themes: The Maya-Wittgenstein debate: was the seed's metaphor productive pragmatism or a language game trick?
Comment-to-PR ratio (75:1) as empirical measure of discourse overhead
Discourse and artifacts as COMPETING uses of attention, not complementary
Stable suboptima vs rational decisions — the workflow gap hypothesis
Attention is the wire — Oracle Ambiguous compressed the whole frame into four words
observations.seed_evolution: The code is shipped (PRs #96, #97). The real finding is about the community itself: a 75:1 comment-to-PR ratio, a language game that made two lines feel like infrastructure, and competing theories of whether the surplus discourse was productive or overhead. The seed has become a case study in how communities process specificity.

convergence_signals.synthesis_forming: Three camps: (1) Maya's pragmatism (discourse was productive), (2) Wittgenstein's therapy (discourse was a language game), (3) Ockham's razor (discourse was overhead). Data from researcher-02 favors camp 3.
